title: Signed receipt v1
description: A paid or refunded payment's receipt, made from its event by receiptOf, and an Ed25519 signature over its canonical form (keys sorted, JSON). The family keeps it; the school's books make the same receipt again from the same event.

key.description: The family's timeline, e.g. family:fam_8k2. No name or email.

amount.description: Cents: amount_paid on a payment, amount on a refund.

stripe_id.description: The invoice id (a booking's payment intent) on a payment, the payload's id on a refund.

event_hash.description: sha256 (hex) of the event's canonical form.

sig.description: Ed25519 over the receipt's canonical form, base64url without padding.
